groups.title: Heating
groups.summary: Heating repairs, replacements and maintenance for the handful of cold weeks on the island.
groups.intro: Your heating system is vital to the comfort of your home or business, and on the island it sits idle most of the year. We repair, replace and maintain heating systems for residential and commercial customers, 24 hours a day.

groups.title: Indoor Air Quality
groups.summary: The air inside the house, handled by the same technicians who service the system.
groups.intro: Our technicians are available 24/7 for all your heating, cooling and indoor air quality needs. The air inside a Galveston home travels through the same system that cools it, so it is handled by the same crew on the same visit.

about.title: Over 35 years in the industry, on the island.
text: Kovich A/C & Heating provides trusted service to Galveston County and the surrounding areas, for homes and for businesses, on repairs and on new installations alike.
Our team has been in the industry for over 35 years and are known and recommended for their honesty, integrity and quality workmanship.
Our technicians are available 24/7 for all your heating, cooling and indoor air quality needs.

values.title: Available 24/7

faqs.q: Are you available at night and on weekends?
faqs.a: Yes. Our technicians are available 24/7 for all your heating, cooling and indoor air quality needs.

faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate on a new system?
faqs.a: No. Estimates for new installations are free.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial buildings as well as homes?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle residential and commercial work, both repairs and installations.
Luxaire, American Standard and Rheem are our preferred brands and manufacturers.
